profile.headline: Software Engineer at Global Wireless Solutions, Inc.
profile.summary:
•	5 years of experience in Software development, specialize in Microsoft Technology. 
•	Hands on Developing custom applications using .Net Technologies. 
•	Designed and developed applications for various businesses including Hospital, Finance and Banking.
•	Excellent analytical, problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills.
•	Self-Motivated, a fast learner and adaptive to new technology.
•	Demonstrated ability to work well with a wide variety of people at various levels. A self-starter with positive attitude, willingness to learn new concepts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed, maintained and deployed desktop application using C#, VB.NET

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed, maintained and deployed web-based financial applications systems with WCF services using C#, MVC, HTML, CSS, jQuery and Ajax
•	Created, developed and maintained databases, primarily Microsoft SQL, along with creating and executing SQL queries and stored procedures
•	Generated reports using SQL Server Data Tools for Business Intelligence.
•	Worked in agile environment development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed several  Win Forms applications with C# and VB.
•	Designing, enhancing and a maintaining user interface; worked with back-end developers to implement front-end and user interface requirements.
•	Environment: Visual Studio 2010, SQL Server 2010.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	Participated in all phases of SDLC: user requirement gathering, analysis, design implementation and testing.
o	Created architecture and design documentations using Visio UML Diagram. 
o	Created Tables, Stored Procedures and Functions in SQL Server 2008.

positions.title: Loan Officer
positions.description:
•	Located potential clients, individuals or businesses in need of loans.
•	Work with clients to identify their financial goals and to find ways of reaching those goals.
•	Analyze applicants’ financial status, credit, and property evaluations to determine feasibility of granting loans.
•	Assisted clients throughout the loan application process
•	Review loan agreement to ensure that they are complete and accurate according to policy
•	Generated reports
•	Filed and maintained confidential documents
•	Ensured compliance with government regulations and standards
•	Approve loans within specified limits, and refer loan applications outside those limits to management for approval.

skills.name: •	.NET technology: C#, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, LINQ, Entity Framework.
•	Development tool: Visual Studio 2010/2008/2005, Eclipse, UMLet, NetBean
•	Design Tool: Rational Rose, MS Visio 2010, Dreamweaver
•	Web Development: ASP.NET, PHP, HTML, XHTML, CSS, AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery
•	Database: MS SQL Server 2008/2005, MySQL, Oracle, MS Access.
